title: Rohan AAC voice production package
voiceQualities: capable of pauses between scanned selections

allowed: Licensed performer recording under character voice agreement
Explicitly authorised synthetic voice with documented licence covering character AAC use
forbidden: Cloning a real child’s voice without consent
Using unconsented likeness or voice of any minor
Adding background music to isolated AAC takes
licensing.consentNotes: See content/canon/consent-rules.json — voice, likeness, and symptom-language rules. Rohan’s AAC lines are authored content requiring production consent even when fictional.

lines.pronunciation: Slow AN-swer. Still AN-swer. Equal stress on both clauses. Brief pause at the full stop.
lines.usage: Canon — reuse verbatim; do not paraphrase into defeat framing.

lines.pronunciation: TELL me be-FORE MED-i-cine. Clear consonants; no rush on before.
lines.usage: Consent and timing of treatment changes.

lines.pronunciation: Com-mu-ni-CA-tion when eyes OPEN. Pause after communication if scanning.

lines.text: THE LAST EMERGENCY IS HISTORY. CHECK WHAT THIS ONE IS.
lines.pronunciation: The last e-MER-gen-cy is HIS-to-ry. [pause] Check what THIS one is.

lines.text: THE AMBULANCE KEPT THE CODE GOING.
lines.pronunciation: The AM-bu-lance kept the code GO-ing. Do not soften into apology tone.
lines.usage: Locked chronology — ambulance performed CPR; no sustained ROSC in transit.

lines.text: THE RESUSCITATION BAY GOT THE PULSE BACK.
lines.pronunciation: The re-sus-ci-TA-tion bay got the pulse BACK. Slight emphasis on bay.
lines.usage: Locked chronology — sustained circulation restored in the resuscitation bay.

lines.text: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.
lines.pronunciation: NOW ask me what HAP-pens next. Direct, not pleading.

lines.text: NOT EVERY ALARM IS A CODE.
lines.pronunciation: Not EV-ery a-larm is a CODE. Calm precision.

lines.text: EVERY ALARM STILL DESERVES AN ANSWER.
lines.pronunciation: EV-ery a-larm still de-SERVES an AN-swer.

deliverables.slowAlternate: public/media/aac/{line-id}-slow.wav (slots) — same text, longer inter-clause pauses, ~0.85× perceived pace without pitch caricature
